notablePrerequisites:
Tezzeret has at least two loyalty counters on it.
Basalt Monolith does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Tezzeret's second ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing Basalt Monolith to become an artifact creature.
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Basalt Monolith's last ability by paying at most {2}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.
